thesis: Pool type returns amountOut > actual tokens moved, Core credits user excess
reason: _safeDecrementUint128 underflow check at AMMModule.sol:3520 catches amountOut > reserve. Core also validates balance before/after at line 2208.

thesis: Transfer handler called with mismatched token pair steals from settlement
reason: ammHandleTransfer requires msg.sender==AMM (line 230 CLOBTransferHandler, line 115 PermitTransferHandler). Balance check at AMMModule:2208 catches under-delivery.

thesis: Reentrancy through wrapped native deposit/refund corrupts swap state
reason: Balance-before/after check at AMMModule:2208 validates exact amount transferred. The _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess refund callback cannot manipulate the AMM's balance because WETH deposit is atomic and the excess refund goes to executor.
